name: Six independent holdouts for a prospective counterexample-auditor revision
batch_design: All six cases belong to batch3. They use separate situations rather than sound/defective repaired pairs,so there is no counterpart whose changed wording reveals the disposition.
provider_input_boundary: Only learner_item under an opaque slot may be sent. Never send case_id,family_id,variant,gold,counterexamples,provenance,or these instructions. The auditor may judge the unchanged item but may not repair it.
ground_truth_method: All necessary premises appear in each learner stem;evaluate necessary/sufficient inference by concrete countermodels,geometry by exact arithmetic and strict triangle inequalities,and answer identity using the explicit operational/text rules. No time-sensitive external claim or fallible provider judgment is needed.
